items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Buster Bailey was one of my heroes, and he still is, because I think Buster Bailey... was the best clarinet player I ever knew.

ctx.x: See, then he took over the band. He was a Lieutenant. So then -- so it tied in. So I said to him, I said, "Well, I can't join the band. I'm a violin player. I can't march with a violin." So he says, "Well, I tell you what. There's clarinet players that we need," and he said, "Would you like to play?" I said, "Oh, yeah," because I'd seen Buster Bailey up there with this clarinet. Buster Bailey was one of my heroes, and he still is, because I think Buster Bailey, regardless of what anyone says about Buster Bailey…
